chronicle.text: When the old capital burned, the guild-masters signed the first charter on a table of cooling embers and swore never to rule alone.
The founders rebuilt a ruined clockwork tower and, when it struck noon, declared the hour belonged to everyone.
Their first ships were built from the doors of a flooded city, and every captain still carries one splinter of it.
A shepherd stared at the sun until it spoke, and the first tower was raised where his shadow fell.
A girl planted an acorn on a battlefield, and the army that left it unburned became the first court.
The elders sealed the first pact inside a cave and the echo of it has never faded.
